defect: Funding cashflow used entry notional times the sum of funding rates, although Bybit funding applies to position value at each funding timestamp.
correction: For every canonical funding event, use the last fully observed one-minute close available at the funding timestamp as a causal mark-price proxy. Funding PnL is side-signed quantity times the sum of funding_rate multiplied by that funding-time mark proxy.
why_programization_only: the exact signed canonical funding rates are unchanged
no event, direction, structural level, feature family, model, threshold, cost, risk, leverage, symbol or chronology is changed
the correction makes account replay and daily liquidation NAV conform to the existing realistic-funding contract
quarantined: all economic results produced before PATCH_003_FUNDING_MARK_VALUE.patch is applied and final source hashes are verified
